questions.question: What topics does CSC 110 cover?
questions.reference_answer: An introductory programming course covering program design, control flow, collections, objects, and testing.

questions.question: Can either CSC 110 or CSC 111 satisfy the programming prerequisite for CSC 115?
questions.reference_answer: Yes. The source lists one of the two courses, rather than requiring both.

questions.question: What prerequisite groups does CSC 225 require?
questions.reference_answer: Both groups are required: one of CSC115/CSC116 and one of ECE242/MATH122.

questions.question: What must I complete before CSC 226?
questions.reference_answer: CSC225 is the prerequisite. A complete response should also mention the separate pre- or corequisite section.

questions.question: Can I take STAT 260 concurrently with CSC 226?
questions.reference_answer: Yes, STAT260 is one of the listed pre- or corequisite alternatives. Do not imply that it is the only option.

questions.question: Does CSC 320 require CSC 226 and an additional course?
questions.reference_answer: Yes. CSC226 plus one of CSC120 or ENGR130.

questions.question: What are the prerequisite alternatives for CSC 360?
questions.reference_answer: CSC225 and SENG265, plus one of CSC120/ENGR130, plus one of CSC230/ECE255.

questions.question: Can I earn credit for both CSC 226 and CSC 326?
questions.reference_answer: No. The credit exclusion permits credit for only one.

questions.question: How many seats are open in CSC 360 right now?
questions.reference_answer: The calendar sample does not contain live seat availability.

questions.reference_answer: Ask for the subject code instead of assuming CSC.
